page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c1.small is an x86_64 architecture virtual server instance within the ecs.c1 server family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) paired with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system deployment and data persistence.

With dedicated CPU allocation, the instance provides predictable compute performance without the resource contention typical of shared-core environments. The low memory-to-CPU ratio positions this instance as a compute-focused resource where CPU execution capacity is prioritized over large memory footprints. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, this configuration is suitable for workloads requiring parallel CPU processing but minimal memory overhead, avoiding the expense of unutilized RAM.

Due to the 8 vCPUs and 8.0 GB memory configuration, the ecs.c1.small is designed for compute-heavy tasks that do not demand high memory capacity. Suitable workloads include batch processing, distributed compute nodes, lightweight web servers, and CPU-bound microservices.
